name: hermes
description: Native desktop shell for Hermes Agent.
author: Nous Research

scripts.clean: npm run clean:e2e && npm run clean:renderer && npm run clean:electron
scripts.dev:fake-boot: cross-env HERMES_DESKTOP_BOOT_FAKE=1 HERMES_DESKTOP_BOOT_FAKE_STEP_MS=650 npm run dev
scripts.dev:renderer: node scripts/assert-root-install.mjs && npm run clean:renderer && vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174
scripts.dev:electron: tsc --build tsconfig.electron.json && wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174 && node scripts/bundle-electron-main.mjs --dev && cross-env XCURSOR_SIZE=24 HERMES_DESKTOP_DEV_SERVER=http://127.0.0.1:5174 electron .
scripts.profile:main: tsc --build tsconfig.electron.json && wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174 && node scripts/bundle-electron-main.mjs --dev && cross-env XCURSOR_SIZE=24 HERMES_DESKTOP_DEV_SERVER=http://127.0.0.1:5174 electron --inspect=9229 .
scripts.profile:main:cpu: tsc --build tsconfig.electron.json && wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174 && node scripts/bundle-electron-main.mjs --dev && cross-env XCURSOR_SIZE=24 NODE_OPTIONS=--cpu-prof HERMES_DESKTOP_DEV_SERVER=http://127.0.0.1:5174 electron .
scripts.build: node scripts/assert-root-install.mjs && node scripts/write-build-stamp.mjs && vite build && node scripts/bundle-electron-main.mjs && node scripts/stage-native-deps.mjs
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run builder -- --dir --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run builder -- --mac
scripts.dist:mac:dmg: npm run build && npm run builder -- --mac dmg
scripts.dist:mac:zip: npm run build && npm run builder -- --mac zip
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run builder -- --win
scripts.dist:win:msi: npm run build && npm run builder -- --win msi
scripts.dist:win:nsis: npm run build && npm run builder -- --win nsis
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run builder -- --linux AppImage deb rpm
scripts.fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run fmt
scripts.check:lint: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.check: npm run check:lint && npm run test:ui && npm run test:desktop:platforms && npm run test:desktop:all
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test e2e/
scripts.test:e2e:visual: npm run build && WLR_BACKENDS=headless WLR_NO_HARDWARE_CURSORS=1 cage -- npx playwright test e2e/ --reporter=list
scripts.test:e2e:update-snapshots: npm run build && WLR_BACKENDS=headless WLR_NO_HARDWARE_CURSORS=1 cage -- npx playwright test e2e/ --reporter=list --update-snapshots

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Hermes uses audio capture for voice conversations.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Hermes uses the camera when a plugin or feature you enable requests it.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Hermes uses the microphone for voice input and voice conversations.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Hermes needs access to Calendar to provide requested meeting and scheduling support.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Hermes needs full access to Calendar to read and manage events when explicitly requested.
extendInfo.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Hermes needs access to Reminders to provide requested personal-assistant and scheduling support.
extendInfo.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Hermes needs full access to Reminders to read and manage reminders when explicitly requested.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Hermes captures the screen when you ask the agent to screenshot or record it.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Hermes connects to devices on your local network when a plugin or feature you enable requests it.
extendInfo.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: Hermes accesses your music library when a plugin or feature you enable requests it.
